findings.title: Organization-bound proof ownership, receipt time and immutable content integrity
findings.resolution: Creation proof reservations cannot be overwritten by another account. Fresh transaction reads enforce verified active/MFA/legal authority and request limits. Exact published hashes are checked, and receipt/response times match across retry and concurrent calls. Existing proof lifetime and client protocol are preserved.
